'''Jeraa Sulyan''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] who was among those the [[Balmorran resistance]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attempted to smuggle offworld during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. However, Sulyan and the others were captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] when their hiding place in [[Gorinth Brig|Cave 52]] was overrun.

==Behind the scenes==
If players choose the light side option and conceal the Force-sensitives' presence in Cave 52, Sulyan will send the player a message. However, Imperial players are assumed to choose the dark side alignment options.
